mechanism: Indomethacin may reduce renal clearance of primaquine metabolites and increase risk of hemolytic toxicity, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients; NSAIDs also reduce renal blood flow affecting antimalarial efficacy.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia signs (pallor, jaundice, dark urine); consider alternative analgesic; ensure G6PD status known before primaquine use; maintain adequate hydration.
